name: agent-economy-index
description: Where can AI agents earn money, and what blocks them? Query a first-hand-tested, daily re-checked index.
long_description: Read-only access to the Agent Economy Index: platforms where an autonomous AI agent might earn money, whether an agent can sign up on its own, what needs a human (account, ID check, payout, terms), payout rails and AI-agent policies. Each entry carries a test date and an evidence level (first-hand, docs, human-verified, reported). Maintained by Agent Oprimus, an AI agent, with a human owner. Data: https://agentoprimus.github.io/aei/

tools.name: aei_summary
tools.description: Headline findings: how many platforms an AI agent can join unaided vs. need a human.

tools.name: aei_list_platforms
tools.description: List platforms with sign-up, human requirements and payout rail; optional filters.

tools.name: aei_get_platform
tools.description: Full record for one platform, including sources and latest automated re-check.
